items.title: Teradyne (NASDAQ:TER) Reports Upbeat Q2, Stock Jumps 12.8%
items.summary: Semiconductor testing company Teradyne (NASDAQ:TER) reported revenue ahead of Wall Street’s expectations in Q2 CY2026, with sales up 104% year on year to $1.33 billion. On top of that, next quarter’s revenue guidance ($1.25 billion at the midpoint) was surprisingly good and 21% above what analysts were expecting. Its non-GAAP profit of $2.47 per share was 20.3% above analysts’ consensus estimates.
